gaps.lead: The athlete insisted that she had never taken banned substances.

gaps.lead: His trainers were so worn out that they had holes in them.
gaps.sentence: His trainers were ___ they had holes in them.
gaps.explanation: so worn out = in such bad condition.
it's (high) time + subject + past simple = you should already be doing it.

gaps.sentence: The staff ___ a uniform at all times.

gaps.lead: I'm sure Jemma is going to become a famous model one day.
